statements.subject: session
statements.description: The channel identifier is defined in the Transport header with the interleaved parameter (Section 18.54).
statements.guard_semantics: required when embedded interleaved binary data channels are used

statements.subject: session
statements.description: C->S SETUP with Transport: RTP/AVP/TCP;unicast;interleaved=0-1 followed by S->C 200 OK with assigned interleaved channels and Session identifier, establishing interleaved transport channels.
statements.trigger: SETUP request with interleaved transport parameter
actions: assign interleaved channel IDs in Transport header

statements.subject: session
statements.description: C->S PLAY followed by S->C 200 OK then server begins sending interleaved binary data blocks ($005 RTP, $006 RTCP) over the TCP connection.
actions: send 200 OK with RTP-Info and Range
begin sending interleaved RTP/RTCP binary data blocks on assigned channels

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: Interleaved binary data SHOULD only be used if RTSP is carried over TCP.
statements.guard_semantics: interleaved binary data is only permitted when the underlying transport is TCP
